{{MissingInfo|1|enva|}} [[Image:Gary_cheerleaders.png|thumb|250px|Gary's cheerleaders]] '''Gary's cheerleaders''' (Japanese: '''シゲル応援ギャル''' ''Shigeru's cheering gals'') were a group of girls, also considered friends, that traveled with {{Gary}} during his [[Pokémon journey]]. Six of them helped cheer Gary on, much like real-life {{wp|cheerleading|cheerleaders}} at sporting events, while a silent seventh member of the entourage chauffeured the group around in a red convertible car. ==In animation== ===History=== They debuted in ''[[EP001|Pokémon - I Choose You!]]'', where they were seen outside [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]] cheering for Gary as he received [[Gary's Blastoise|his first partner Pokémon]]. Their motto is: :"''Gary, Gary, he's our man. If he can't do it, no one can! Go...Gary!''". The entourage continued to appear alongside Gary; and therefore were seen in ''[[EP018|Beauty and the Beach]]'', ''[[EP031|Dig Those Diglett!]]'', ''[[EP046|Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon]]'', and ''[[EP058|Riddle Me This]]''. His cheerleaders watched Gary challenge {{an|Giovanni}} to a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} in ''[[EP063|The Battle of the Badge]]''. However, they were frightened and later upset when Gary lost to {{OBP|Mewtwo|M01}}. Later, they watched Ash take on the [[Team Rocket trio]], who served as temporary [[Gym Leader]]s while Giovanni had an unrelated business to attend to. Ash went on to earn himself the {{Badge|Earth}}, despite the trio's attempts to cheat, and Gary's cheerleaders cheered for him: :"''He's our winner, he's our Ash! Let's all have a victory bash! He's our winner, he's our man! No one wins like Ketchum can!''". Afterwards, the cheerleaders supported Gary throughout his [[Indigo Plateau Conference]] campaign beginning in ''[[EP074|All Fired Up!]]''. The group was left distraught after Gary's loss to [[Melissa]] in ''[[EP077|The Fourth Round Rumble]]'', and they all left the [[Indigo Plateau]] with Gary soon after. [[File:Gary cheerleaders JN.png|thumb|250px|Gary's cheerleaders in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'']] The cheerleaders were then absent for most of the [[Johto League]]. They finally reappeared in ''[[EP269|The Ties that Bind]]'' and ''[[EP270|Can't Beat the Heat!]]'', where they supported Gary as he competed against {{Ash}} in a [[Full Battle]] round during the [[Silver Conference]]. Unlike the previous battles, they did not start crying when Gary lost to Ash. The cheerleaders haven't made a present day appearance since Gary decided to become a {{pkmn|Professor|Pokémon Researcher}} like his {{an|Professor Oak|grandfather}}, only appearing in a flashback in ''[[JN068|Advice to Goh!]]''. ===Character=== Gary's cheerleaders are a lively group with exuberant personalities. They enjoy a life of luxury, like in ''[[EP058|Riddle Me This]]'', where they took a holiday in a private [[Cinnabar Island]] hotel suite with {{Gary}} prior to the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]]. Their beauty and incredible support for Gary often made {{Ash}} jealous. Conversely, their rhyming slogans and pep bolstered Gary's own confidence, which also helped inflame his ego during his [[Pokémon journey]]. The girls were shown to cry whenever Gary lost a challenge, like in ''[[EP063|The Battle of the Badge]]'' and ''[[EP077|The Fourth Round Rumble]]''. ===Pokémon competitions=== Some of the cheerleaders have competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Beach Beauty and Pokémon Costume Contest]] - N/A (''[[EP018|Beauty and The Beach]]'') ===Voice actresses=== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}}| |ja= '''大谷育江''' ''[[Ikue Otani]]''

In this strip, one of the cheerleaders asked Gary to show the power of his {{p|Rapidash}}. Gary's Rapidash attacked [[Ash's Metapod]] in front of the cheerleaders, but Metapod defeated Rapidash. The cheerleaders then remarked: "Oh, poor Gary!", "That terrible Metapod!" {{-}} ==In the novels== ===Pocket Monsters: The Animation=== In [[Pocket Monsters: The Animation]], Gary's cheerleaders are explained to be hired by the mayor of [[Pallet Town]], who is the older brother of {{an|Professor Oak}} and thus {{Gary}}'s great-uncle. ==Trivia== * In ''[[EP018|Beauty and the Beach]]'', one of the cheerleaders wore a bathing suit very similar to the one {{an|May}} would later wear in ''[[AG012|The Lotad Lowdown]]'' and ''[[AG019|Sharpedo Attack!]]''. * In the Japanese version, they are referred to as his girlfriends. * Gary’s cheerleaders are the only recurring characters that are present in [[EP001|the first episode]] to not appear in ''[[JN147|The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!]]'', the last episode with {{Ash}} as a protagonist. {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Female characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Newspaper Strip characters]] [[es:Animadoras de Gary]] [[it:Cheerleader di Gary]] [[ja:シゲル応援ギャル]] [[zh:小茂的啦啦隊]]
